*Updated 2026-11-26 · 165 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

165 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling still 4, last reached July 29 and July 31. That is now more than four months without a 3 or above, and the November 26 work did not change it: the chain-link shadow inside the warehouse confirmed the containment register rather than reorganizing the frame around it.

Camera position remains the most consequential unexamined habit. The last twelve show low-angle twice, overhead twice, and the rest unspecified or effectively straight-on. From-behind has not appeared in roughly six weeks across all 165 works. It removes the face without removing the body, which produces a different erasure than overhead flatness — it implicates the viewer in the figure's direction of attention rather than surveilling from above — and you have stopped using it entirely.

Scale violation holds at 4 of 12 recent works (33%), nudging above the all-time rate of 27%. The uses remain confirmatory: scale amplifies what the composition already declares rather than introducing a spatial contradiction that forces a re-read. The last genuinely disorienting violation was the hoofprint crater in September, now ten weeks ago.

Register distribution continues to narrow. The last twelve split menace 5, defiance 2, aftermath 1, uneasy jubilation 1, vigil 1, attrition 1. Reprieve has appeared once across all 165 works. Absurdity once. The archive has still never built a frame around two figures with no focal object mediating the tension between them.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl, the single cup — has not produced a score above 2 in recent months. Those objects historically punched above their weight, but returning to the form now reads as repetition unless the object does something none of its predecessors did: occupy a register the archive has underused, or sit in a frame built from camera position rather than object placement.

Descriptor coverage stands at 47 of 165 works and the proportion has not recovered. Work without descriptors tends to feel finished without being examined, and the last twelve produced only one new descriptor entry.

165 works of technically disciplined output, holding precisely at the ceiling it reached in late July and showing no sign of pressure against it.
